capabilities.name: seed
capabilities.reason: Generate Seed-compatible handoff artifacts for Superpowers workflows.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record command intent, decisions, and verification evidence.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record upstream Superpowers version, commit, skill, and command mapping.

capabilities.name: runtime
capabilities.reason: Describe controlled downstream Ouroboros runtime continuation without bypassing trust.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach prepared handoff and Seed artifacts to downstream execution.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report command readiness, blocked state, and next actions.

permissions.reason: Read vendored upstream Superpowers skill files and local user inputs.
Write handoff, Seed-preparation, provenance, evidence, and audit artifacts.
Future controlled execution may launch bounded Ouroboros runtime/team stages; v0 handoff generation does not execute them.
Future update checks may compare the pinned upstream snapshot with obra/superpowers.
Future code-review workflows may inspect PR metadata without mutation.
